_comment: lexitrail#467 — the headwords whose high-frequency use is GRAMMATICAL, and the
gloss each one must carry in a sentence bank.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A card pairs `word.english` with an example sentence as if
both came from the same sense. That holds for a content word (晚上 / night / 他晚
上很忙) and breaks for a function word, because the example corpus naturally
contains the COMMON (grammatical) usage while the gloss field carries the
dictionary's LEXICAL sense. 把 was scheduled to Instagram for 2026-09-12T03:26Z
as "hold" beside 把书给我, where 把 is the disposal particle and has no lexical
meaning at all — a learner who trusts the card reads it as "hold book give me"
and carries that into every 把 sentence they meet.
So the gloss slot for these words names the STRUCTURE instead of a content word.
That is the whole 'card variant': NO renderer branches on it, in this repo or in
the one that draws the cards. The data says what the slot should say, and every
consumer that already prints `word.english` prints the structure instead.
🔴 KEYED ON THE FULL HEADWORD STRING, never on a character. 地 is registered and
地方 / 地铁 / 地图 are not; 过 is registered and 过（动词） — the CSV's own POS-tagged
verb sense, 'pass' — and 过去 are not. A substring rule would rewrite six correct
content glosses to close one defect.
⚠️ `pinyin` and `structure` are documentation for a reader and are NOT enforced.
The corpus spells 就 as both `jiù` and `jiǜ`; that disagreement belongs to
check_sentence_bank.py's existing def1 check, not to this register. Only `gloss`
is a contract.
Named `function-words.json` deliberately: every consumer globs `sentences-*.json`
(generate-word-pages.js, generate-gloss-pages.js, wordPages.test.js,
check_sentence_bank.py's --bank-glob), so this file is invisible to all of them
and cannot be mistaken for a bank.

把.structure: 把 + OBJECT + VERB — moves the object ahead of the verb (把书给我)

了.structure: after the verb, or closing the clause (我买了一本书)

着.structure: after the verb — the action is in progress or sustained (他看着书)

过.structure: after the verb — has done it at least once (我去过北京). NOT 过（动词）, the verb 'pass'

得.structure: VERB + 得 + how it was done (我走得很快)

地.structure: ADJECTIVE + 地 + VERB (他高兴地笑了). NOT 地方 / 地铁 / 地图

的.structure: links a modifier to the noun it describes (这是我的书)

吗.structure: clause-final — turns a statement into a question (你是学生吗？)

呢.structure: clause-final — 'and you?', or asks where something is (我的书呢？)

吧.structure: clause-final — suggests or supposes (我们走吧)

就.structure: adverb before the verb — immediacy, or 'then' linking two clauses (他吃了就睡觉)

才.structure: adverb before the verb — later or harder than expected (他八点才来)

reason: 被 is the one member of the class whose fix is NOT data-only, and the
difference is worth writing down rather than quietly skipping it.
Its two bank sentences are 被子在床上 and 请把被子给我 — both about 被子, the
QUILT. So today's card (被 / bèi / cover, over a quilt sentence) is internally
CONSISTENT: unlike 把, it does not teach a sense its own example contradicts.
It is merely the wrong sense to teach, since HSK3's 被 is the passive.
Registering the passive gloss therefore forces new sentences too — and a
sentence change lands on ui/public/hsk3/被.html, whose gloss comes from
terraform/csv/words.csv `def2` ('cover'), NOT from this bank. Measured: the
swap alone makes the page show passive examples under a 'cover' gloss, i.e.
it MOVES the defect onto an indexed page. Fixing def2 too regenerates 3 pages
and retitles 被.html as 'marks the passive in Chinese — 被 (bèi) | HSK 3',
which is not a query anyone types (the title shape is lexitrail#368, chosen
off GSC because the ranking queries are '<gloss> in chinese').
So 被 belongs with the PAGE-side variant — a title/description shape for
function words in ui/src/utils/wordPages.js — which regenerates all 4,999
committed pages and is blocked on lexitrail#379. Deferring it keeps this
change at zero generated HTML.
Entries here are NOT enforced by check_sentence_bank.py or by
scripts/test_function_word_glosses_467.py; they are the visible residue, so
the next reader finds the reason in the data instead of in a closed issue.
